evidence.description: The notification center dependency is hard-coded to NotificationCenter.default.
The globally obtained notification center performs state-change broadcasting.
dispatchAuthState directly accesses EcosiaAuthWindowRegistry.shared and uses its registered windows to dispatch authentication actions.

candidates.explanation: The manager directly obtains operational dependencies from global singleton access points rather than receiving them through an explicit, replaceable dependency boundary. It uses the shared window registry to select dispatch targets and the default notification center to broadcast state changes.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access
